pretreatments.description: Sedimentation and centrifugation (5 min, 3000 rpm) for harvesting microalgae biomass
Thermal-pretreatment conducted for 30 min at temperatures of 50 °C, 80 °C, and 120 °C
Ultrasonic pretreatments conducted for 30, 90, and 180 s using an ultrasonicator of 130 W
Alkali pretreatment adjusted to pH 9, 11, and 13 using 5 N NaOH
